alternatives.argument: The carrier defines the De Concini–Kac, Lusztig, and small root-power constructions explicitly, fixes the toral convention, and asserts no generic inclusion after specialization or higher-rank Frobenius theorem.

The proof is local to sl2: rewrite to F^a K^b E^c, use the generic rank-one basis and free base change, compute both root-power commutators, and verify the coproduct, counit, and antipode on the ideal generators. This does not prove the higher-rank quotient theorem.
The rank-one target relation E^ell=[ell]_zeta! E^(ell) kills E^ell, while the proved De Concini–Kac PBW basis keeps E^ell nonzero; this proves only the rank-one specialization statement.

The carrier defines filtrations and negligible morphism subspaces from explicitly supplied category, module-family, pivotal-trace, and braiding data; it deliberately asserts no ideal closure, semisimplicity, fusion rule, or modularity theorem.
